verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform for ISVs/merchant onboarding, payouts, disputes, and webhooks, but no evidence describes a split-payments or marketplace fund-routing API (multi-party charge splitting, take-rate/application fee objects, or reversible splits). Evidence covers merchant onboarding, pricing templates, payouts, disputes, and white-labeling, none of which address splitting a single charge among multiple sellers.
